headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more over neoclouds across all six GPUs, with H100 SXM's premium the widest.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 versus $3.82 at neoclouds and $2.48 on marketplaces.
MI300X leads on price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at a $0.50 median against a $2.39 market index.
B200 holds the top market index at $6.84, with neocloud ($6.81) and marketplace ($6.90) medians nearly level, while hyperscalers sit at $14.24 (+109%).
A100 80GB SXM has the narrowest hyperscaler premium at +100%, but it is the weakest on price-performance at $7.02 per PFLOP-hour.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for four of six GPUs, and Vast.ai is cheapest for H100 SXM ($2.27) and A100 80GB SXM ($1.19).
watch: Watch for the first 7-day changes once history reaches the 7-day trend window, especially whether MI300X's $0.50 marketplace pricing holds with only 3 providers listing it.
